Therefore, the precise combination 'dry with no sputum or blood' is not cleanly captured.

Gold: call back if breathlessness or wheezing occurs or cough persists >3 weeks. Generated plan-006 and fu-001 describe seeking medical attention/contact if shortness of breath or wheezing develops and if symptoms persist beyond three weeks, which captures the same follow-up triggers.
